name: scribe-devtools
description: Developer tools in the scribe spirit: scripts instead of MCP servers, results on disk. Home of browser-inspector 2 — batch flows and an interactive session on one step table over playwright-core — and of its benchmark against @playwright/mcp.

scripts.verify: prettier --check . && node scripts/check-pins.mjs && vitest run --project !smoke && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/index-code.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-steps-doc.mjs --check && node scripts/check-instruction-sync.mjs --require-all && npm run smoke
